note: Street network for the London Bridge district (the realism benchmark). Loaded by src/scene/street/network.ts for site 'london' only; other sites and the overview outside the district keep the generated lattice. Points are [lat, lon]. `years` = when the street is used for placing houses and drawing its surface; zones still decide when each house exists. Evidence: attested-* lines name the street from a source but their exact line here is estimated from the landmarks already in the data and the map views (see `positional`); conjectural lines are generated. See docs/STREETS.md.

streets.name: New Fish Street / Fish Street Hill
streets.source: Copperplate map (c. 1553-59) and the 'Agas' woodcut (c. 1561-70); Stow, A Survey of London (1603), 'Bridgewarde within'
streets.note: Runs north from the bridge foot. North of Thames Street it is laid on the line of the Roman road from the bridge (landmark road-ermine), which the medieval street is generally taken to follow; the bend at Thames Street is a modelling choice to meet the medieval bridge at the site origin.

reach.note: The street was carried south to the bridge as the waterfront was reclaimed. Its south end in each period follows this model's reclaimed bank (site.river.northBankSetback, ground at least 0.45 m above high water); until it reaches the bridge's line the bridge's approach and ramp meet it there. The dates of each extension are the model's.

streets.name: Long Southwark / Borough High Street
streets.source: Copperplate map (c. 1553-59) and the 'Agas' woodcut (c. 1561-70); Stow, Survey of London: Bridge warde without; Wyngaerde (c. 1544), Norden (1600) and Visscher (1616) panoramas
streets.note: On the line of the Roman road south from the bridge (landmark road-watling-south). Wide at the bridge foot, where the Southwark market stood.

reach.note: Its last few metres at the bridge foot are foreshore in the model; the street ends where the ground is dry and the bridge's ramp meets it.

reach.note: Its line runs onto the Southwark marsh, which was embanked piecemeal. Its end in each period follows this model's embanked ground (site.river.southEmbankment, at least 0.45 m above high water), not a documented line; the dates of each extension are the model's.
